```plato
//==
// # Kinematics interfaces
//
// The sampling interface shared by closed-form and recorded motions: a motion
// that can be asked for its position and velocity at any time since its
// start. Linear quantities are in meters and seconds.

// A planar motion that can be sampled at any time. PositionAt returns the
// position in meters at the given time since the motion's start; VelocityAt
// returns the velocity in meters per second.
interface IKinematic2D
{
    PositionAt(x: Self, time: Duration): Point2D;
    VelocityAt(x: Self, time: Duration): Vector2D;
}

// A spatial motion that can be sampled at any time. PositionAt returns the
// position in meters at the given time since the motion's start; VelocityAt
// returns the velocity in meters per second.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinematics)
interface IKinematic3D
{
    PositionAt(x: Self, time: Duration): Point3D;
    VelocityAt(x: Self, time: Duration): Vector3D;
}
```
